title: Array Prototype ForEach
summary: Implement forEach on arrays: call the callback once per element in index order with (value, index, array), using the optional thisArg as the callback's this, and return undefined.
inputFormat: A callback function and an optional thisArg, applied to an array (the array is the receiver).
edgeRules: Holes and length changes during iteration are named in the draft but their rule is not stated.
